scope: Corrected prospective Ready contract only; historical completed six criteria and verdicts remain unchanged. No new acceptance evaluation or provider work.

criteria.check: Decoded Ready image is 16x16 pixels and static (one frame).
criteria.basis: Owner dimensions and static Ready behavior; view frames=1.

criteria.check: The image has a transparent background rather than an opaque canvas matte. Intentional subject shapes, backing shapes and partial-alpha edges are permitted when the background remains transparent and the silhouette readable. No binary-alpha, bare-glyph, component-count or exact empty-margin rule applies.
criteria.basis: Transparent backgrounds is the required outcome; the owner supplies no alpha recipe or backing-shape ban.

criteria.check: Ready visibly uses a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion. No exact arm ratio, stroke width, backing shape, highlights or motif-only construction is required.
criteria.basis: Literal current owner outcome; compare Ready alone at declared display conditions.
criteria.scope: Ready sample; family distinctions remain later collective work

criteria.check: The silhouette is readable at 1x and 3x nearest-neighbor scale on the actual #172336 dark panel.
criteria.basis: Owner display inspection and readable silhouette; panel value is consumer observation.

criteria.check: The image visibly uses the existing UI cool blue accent. It may combine that accent with neutral or other colors; blue need not dominate. No exact-hex, palette-count, coverage or hue-threshold rule applies.
criteria.basis: Owner asks to use cool blue accent and explicitly does not require a fixed palette. Start fill is the existing accent cue, not approved pixel-art style.

criteria.check: For this proposed representative sample, assess deliberate cluster and edge construction, silhouette clarity and absence of accidental noisy pixels or resampling blur; judge whether its treatment is a plausible starting point for Working, Retry and Paused. Intentional anti-aliasing, partial-alpha edge pixels, detached details and backing shapes are allowed.
criteria.basis: PIXL expert judgment for this sample, motivated by coherent pixel-art and sample-first brief. These are not universal numeric or palette rules.
criteria.scope: Expert sample-quality review; does not itself adopt family style
